fusions.name: Boarding Leap
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and strike it, which deals 13 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Hop Pike
fusions.desc: Hurls a boarding pike in a long hop at an enemy up to 8 tiles away; it deals 7 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at full range. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rail to Rail
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Next Deck Over
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 15 stamina for the next jump. Once every 6 seconds. Your dodge chance is 4% higher.
